motivation: C1 geometry-local has lower sampled loss than regular local decomposition but much worse frozen-field FEM displacement. Test physical residual generalization without any further fitting.
scope: All 15 frozen terminal fields; no optimization, no checkpoint selection, no FEM field reads in diagnostic script.
interior: 24000 independent uniform-solid points per geometry, NumPy seed 9262026; C1/C8 share points. Also evaluate the original uniform and support-probe training strata separately.
metrics: Unweighted mean squared equilibrium and constitutive residual sums and their sum; residual norm median/p90/p95/p99/max; near-wall <=0.05 and far-wall splits. Record independent/training-uniform ratios. Save actual points and all pointwise five-component residuals.
interpretation: A large independent/training discrepancy is evidence of inadequate sampled residual control for this fitted field. It cannot alone establish error bounds, prove a particular causal mechanism or identify the best remedy.
stop: This is read-only diagnosis. Do not fit a repair or reopen the P2A expansion decision.
